games.name: Final Fantasy
games.description: Edits the shared world state and four party members in the 0x400-0x7FF save block. Repairs the modulo-255 complemented checksum at 0x4FD. Character names use a game-specific codec and are omitted; equipment exposes the full stored byte including its equipped flag.
